description: MainActivity.java is the primary activity class for an Android application demonstrating runtime permission handling for camera access. It displays a button that, when clicked, prompts the user for camera permission and starts a camera preview activity if granted.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages runtime permission requests for camera access and starts a camera preview activity upon permission grant.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and attaches a click listener to the button to initiate camera permission flow.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of runtime permission requests, starting the camera preview if permission is granted.

methods.name: showCameraPreview
methods.description: Checks if camera permission has already been granted; if so, starts the camera preview, otherwise requests permission.

methods.name: requestCameraPermission
methods.description: Requests camera permission, providing rationale via Snackbar if necessary.
